notes.title: Dark Rising Patch 102
notes.content:
A new patch for Dark Rising has been released. This is a very small patch that adds a few tweaks and a new building.

[New]	Pledges gain experience points when killing zombies
[New]	Fountain of health (building that slowly heals pledges)

[Bug]	Javelin throwers not working
[Bug]	Net throwers not working correctly
[Bug] 	Some levels would stop producing enemies and cause the game to stop progressing

notes.title: Dark Rising Patch 101
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm happy to announce the first patch for Dark Rising has been released. This patch fixes quite a few small bugs and a few larger ones that were affecting gameplay. Below is a list of changes, fixes, and tweaks that come with the latest update:

[b][New][/b]	Added a stand ground stance to keep pledges from wandering off
[b][New][/b]	Volume sliders for music and master sound

[b][Tweak][/b]	Improved single clicking to select units
[b][Tweak][/b]	Nighttime and overall brightness has been increased
[b][Tweak][/b]	You can now train pledges and build your village in the first level
[b][Tweak][/b]	Achievements have been slightly rebalanced
[b][Tweak][/b]	Swamp Level 01 has one less round
[b][Tweak][/b]	Spiders give more gold when killed
[b][Tweak][/b]	Zombies are more resistant to arrow fire

[b][Bug][/b]	Enemy would stop spawning in Skylands Level 02
[b][Bug][/b]	Adding spikes to a castle would cause pathfinding problems
[b][Bug][/b]	When placing a building and switching the type of building, the player would lose the ablity to select and control units.
[b][Bug][/b]	When offline, score would not be displayed correctly after level
[b][Bug][/b]	Shadows would move in the wrong direction at mid-day
[b][Bug][/b]	Tower flames were not always appearing on damaged tower
[b][Bug][/b]	Tower collapse animation missing
[b][Bug][/b]	Stone castle preview had front garrison slots facing wrong direction
[b][Bug][/b]	Royal castle glitches (rotation error)
[b][Bug][/b]	Can't select stone castle ingame
[b][Bug][/b]	Skylands 01 chapel gather path is not visible

[h1]Upcoming Content[/h1]
 Although Dark Rising has been released, I still want to keep updating the game and adding some new content. In the near future I'll be adding:

[list]
[*]Pledges gain experience points when killing zombies
[*]New enemy type that is especially good at destroying towers
[*]Fountain of health (building that slowly heals pledges)
[/list] 

So stay tuned and expect some new content coming up soon.

notes.title: Dark Rising Released
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce, the day has finally arrived. Dark Rising has been released on Steam. I hope everyone will enjoy the game and all feedback is welcome and truly appreciated.

I am currently waiting for Valve to give the "greenlight" on trading cards for Dark Rising. As soon as they do, 5 trading cards will be released. The five trading cards will represent some of the units in the game:

[list]
[*]The Ghost
[*]The Golem
[*]The Monster
[*]The Zombie
[*]The Pledge
[/list]

-Josh
